_comment: Which Korean document replaces which English one on the generated `ko` branch.
`ko` is not a place to edit. It is built from `main` by scripts/ko_sync.py, so the
canonical Korean text lives here on main as `<name>.ko.md` beside its English
sibling, and the branch is regenerated whenever main's tests pass. Editing ko
directly loses the edit at the next sync.
The branch existed as an independent fork until v0.5.5 and was three releases
behind: it still told Korean readers that the tool made no network request and that
installing meant downloading a release. Two languages of the same product cannot be
v0.5.6 finished the job. There is no `not_yet_translated` pile any more, because a
list of documents nobody has got to is indistinguishable from a list of documents
nobody will. What stays English is in `intentionally_english`, each with the reason,
and the suite requires every human-facing document to be in one list or the other.

intentionally_english.LICENSE: The authoritative licence text. A translation would be a second licence.
intentionally_english.skills/codex-auto-resume/SKILL.md: Instructions Codex reads to operate the plugin, not prose a person reads. Translating it would make the two branches behave differently, which is exactly what generating ko from main exists to prevent.
intentionally_english..github/GENERATED-BRANCH.md: Written by the generator, for maintainers, and only exists on ko.
